entities.name: 微交易 (microtransactions)
entities.how_described: 本集说智能体支付是零星小额（一美分、十美分量级）但频率极高；卖方顺势把数据子集包进付费墙（「付 10 美分拿走这份数据」），信用卡 3% 手续费模型完全不可持续

evidence.quote: And that's why these are tiny microtransactions, but highly frequent.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_01

entities.name: 护栏 (guardrails)
entities.how_described: 本集说把护栏直接内置进钱包——设单笔/每会话/每日最大支出额——人不必逐笔审批（那无法扩展），智能体在预算框内自主消费

evidence.quote: You sort of build these guardrails into the wallet, and you don't have to, as a human, approve every single transaction, because that would just not scale, because these agents are just making these $0.05, $0.10 transactions.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_01

evidence.quote: You want to enforce those guardrails, which is, hey, this is the max amount you can spend per session, or this is the max cap you can do per day and stuff like that.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_01

evidence.quote: So the agent is still spending within the guardrails that you set, but it is autonomous enough to make these individual API calls.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_01

evidence.quote: And it provided a query, and again, set the max amount guardrails, and is now passing all the results.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_01

evidence.quote: The agents can now hold their money, spend that money autonomously, but within the guardrails that you set.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_01

evidence.quote: The wallets enforce those guardrails.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_01
